subject.title: feat: session and link context menus support single-key keyboard shortcuts

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR proceed with fixed Latin, menu-open accelerators after the branch is refreshed, or should this shortcut behavior be folded into the broader Control UI shortcut design first?
rationale: The implementation shape is narrow and appears correct, but fixed single-key accelerators are new user-facing shortcut behavior and the PR carries a protected maintainer label plus a live merge conflict.

options.title: Accept Menu-Scoped Accelerators
options.body: Refresh the branch, rerun focused validation, and land the local menu-open shortcut behavior as a bounded ergonomics improvement.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Shortcuts
options.body: Keep the work open but coordinate the accelerator contract with the guarded dashboard shortcut issues before landing one-off menu behavior.

options.title: Defer Fixed Letters
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want fixed Latin single-key menu actions in Control UI context menus.

recommendation.title: Accept Menu-Scoped Accelerators
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, rerun focused validation, and land the local menu-open shortcut behavior as a bounded ergonomics improvement.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent merged menu surfaces and is the active maintainer-team author of the PR.
